decisions.reason: This condenser remains close to the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, and another year of customer feedback, testing and in-house R&D makes improvement more likely than withdrawal.
It also fits the firm's established capabilities and can be commercially learned from, but its overlap with other condenser offerings leaves it with the highest rationalization risk in the range.
The tube liner draws directly on the firm's installed-base service business and corrosion expertise, so absorptive capacity is high and the case for retention is strong.
A customized industrial air cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented model, engineering resources and broad customer base, making continued development clearly preferable to exit.
These repair inserts complement lifecycle services and rely on existing maintenance know-how, which supports ongoing incremental improvement and a low likelihood of withdrawal.
